glosses: to apply, to put on, to dab (e.g. sunscreen) [with instrumental ‘with what’]
to put on, to dress (to put clothing either on oneself or another) [with dative ‘whom’]
to ladle, to put into (to place into a container or dish) [with accusative] or [with genitive ‘what’], [with dative ‘for whom’],
to impose (to enforce, compel to behave in a certain way)
to add too much of something, to put too much
to accustom (to get someone used to something)
to overlap (to extend over and partly cover something)
to overlap (to happen at the same time)
to become accustomed, to get used to

examples.text: Nałożyła mu na talerz uczciwy kawał mięsa.
